brief:
Palestine Action, a UK-based activist group that authorities banned last year, has spawned affiliated organizations in Italy, Canada, and other countries, according to Al Jazeera English. The network targets what it characterizes as Israel's military industrial complex, with cells in multiple nations adopting similar tactics and messaging.

The expansion reflects growing coordination among pro-Palestinian activists internationally, though the groups operate independently rather than under unified command. Supporters say the decentralized model allows movements to evade legal restrictions while maintaining ideological alignment with the original UK organization's stated mission.
dek: The banned UK group, which targets Israel's war machine, has inspired activists in Europe and beyond.
title: UK Palestine Action group inspires banned offshoots across Europe and Canada
